definitions.explanation: A young bear. Also written {小熊|こぐま} or {子|こ}グマ. In children's stories and toys it is a common character, as in English "little bear".

examples.english: The bear cub climbed a tree.

examples.japanese: {母熊|ははぐま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子熊|こぐま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: The mother bear is protecting her cub.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子熊|こぐま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけたら→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧、{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{母熊|ははぐま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: If you see a bear cub in the mountains, its mother is nearby, so do not go near it.

notes:
⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) + ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧ (bear), with the usual sound change く → ぐ. Other young animals are named the same way: ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧ (puppy), {子猫|こねこ} (kitten), ⟦{子馬|こうま}→子馬：19287_kouma⟧ (foal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子熊|こぐま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れた→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧{母熊|ははぐま}: a mother bear with her cub
- {子熊|こぐま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ぬいぐるみ→ぬいぐるみ：05289_nuigurumi⟧: a teddy bear

USAGE:
The constellation Ursa Minor is こぐま⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (the Little Bear).
